welcome.title: Welcome to LiftTrace
welcome.desc: Trace every rep. Your personal weightlifting companion — private, self-hosted, and built for serious lifters.

name.title: What should we call you?
name.desc: Used in greetings, the side menu, and your AI assistant. You can change it later in Settings.

profile.title: About you
profile.desc: A few details so LiftTrace can estimate calories burned and tailor the AI assistant. All optional.
profile.hint: These power the calorie-burn estimate (off by default — turn it on in Settings → Workout). You can edit anything later in Settings → My Profile.

users.create_admin_desc: Your LiftTrace instance requires an admin account. This is the first user and will have full control over the app.
users.multi_user_desc: LiftTrace can run in single-user mode (default) or multi-user mode with separate logins and password resets. You can always enable this later in Settings.

goals.title: Weekly Goal
goals.desc: How many days per week do you want to train?

library.title: Exercise Library
library.desc: Pick what to import. All downloads come directly from upstream sources. You can add or remove these any time from Settings.

profile.delete_account_message: Your workouts, body stats, programs, settings, and AI history will be permanently removed. This cannot be undone.

users.enable_um_subtitle: Add multiple user accounts with separate data & settings
users.create_admin_explainer: This will enable user management. The first account is always admin. All existing workout data will be assigned to this account.

auto.env_lock_title: Locked by BACKUP_SCHEDULE / BACKUP_TIME / BACKUP_RETENTION env var
auto.retention_note: Keeps the {n} newest backup, older archives prune automatically after each run.
auto.retention_note_plural: Keeps the {n} newest backups, older archives prune automatically after each run.
auto.retention_note_local: Keeps the {n} newest auto-backup, manual exports are never pruned.
auto.retention_note_local_plural: Keeps the {n} newest auto-backups, manual exports are never pruned.

full.desc: A complete snapshot of everything: all workout data, programs, exercises, settings, and uploaded images. Saved on the server and available to download or restore at any time.
full.empty: No backups yet, tap Create Backup to get started.

danger.clear_settings_desc: Resets preferences to defaults. Workout data is kept.
danger.clear_data_desc: Deletes all workouts, programs, body stats, and chat history. Cannot be undone.

dialogs.restore_msg: This will replace all current data with the contents of this backup. This cannot be undone.
dialogs.upload_restore_msg: This will replace all current data with the contents of the uploaded backup. This cannot be undone.
dialogs.delete_backup_msg: This backup file will be permanently removed from the server.
dialogs.clear_data_msg: This will permanently delete all your workouts, programs, body stats, personal records, and chat history. Settings and exercises will be kept. This cannot be undone.
dialogs.clear_settings_msg: This will reset all preferences (appearance, units, notifications, integrations) back to their defaults. Your workout data will not be touched.

toast.connected: Trace AI connected, assistant is ready
toast.fill_required: Fill in provider, API key, and model first

labels.enable_desc: Adds a floating chat button to all pages
labels.base_url_desc: Any OpenAI Compatible /v1/chat/completions endpoint, Ollama, LM Studio, LocalAI, vLLM, llama.cpp's server, DeepSeek, Groq, Together AI, Mistral La Plateforme, etc. Don't include the path, just the origin.
labels.reliability_title: Tool calls / vision reliability varies by model.
labels.reliability_body: Llama 3.1+, Mistral, Qwen 2.5+ handle reasoning well. Smaller or older models may struggle with Smart Log parsing. If you're unsure, start with a known-good model and verify chat works before relying on it.
labels.custom_hint: Enter the exact model ID from the vendor. Use this if the preset dropdown doesn't have the model you want.
labels.key_hint_oai: Local endpoints (Ollama, LM Studio, etc.) typically don't need a key. Cloud providers like DeepSeek or Groq do, get one from their dashboard.

toast.issuer_client_required: Issuer URL and Client ID are required
toast.redirect_required: At least one redirect URI is required
toast.need_active_provider: Add at least one active OIDC provider before disabling password login.

empty.user_mgmt_required_desc: Single Sign-On is scoped to user accounts, so User Management has to be enabled first. Set it up in Settings → User Management, then come back here.
empty.admin_only_desc: Only admins can configure identity providers. If you need this access, ask the admin of this LiftTrace instance to promote your account.

providers.section_desc: Authentik, Keycloak, Pocket ID, Authelia, Auth0, Google, etc. Users sign in with their existing identity provider.
providers.env_lock_title: Configured via environment variables, edit your .env / docker-compose to change
providers.empty: No providers configured yet. Click + Add Provider to set one up, or define them in your .env using the OIDC_* variables (see README).

form.client_secret_edit: Client Secret (Leave Blank to Keep Existing)
form.redirect_note: Must match exactly what your IdP has configured. The path is /api/auth/oidc/callback/<provider-id> under your LiftTrace base URL.
form.auto_link_desc: When the IdP says email_verified=true and the email matches an existing LiftTrace user, link them silently on first SSO sign-in. Recommended ON for any IdP you trust to verify emails.
form.auto_register_desc: Allow anyone with an account at this IdP to create a brand-new LiftTrace account on first sign-in. OFF = admin must invite first. Leave OFF for shared IdPs (Google, work SSO) unless you actually want blanket onboarding.
form.provider_active_desc: Inactive providers won't show on the Login page.
form.admin_group_claim_desc: Name of the claim that lists user groups. Common: groups.
form.admin_group_value_desc: If a user's groups claim contains this value, they're set to admin on each login.

password_login.label: Allow Password Login
password_login.desc: When off, users sign in only via OIDC. Recovery still works via the RECOVERY_TOKEN env var.

confirm.delete_provider: Delete provider "{name}"? Linked users will lose this sign-in option.
confirm.disable_password: Disable password login? Users without an OIDC link will not be able to sign in until you re-enable it. RECOVERY_TOKEN will still work.

settings_appearance.persistent_sidebar_desc: Sidebar stays open and shifts page content instead of overlaying it. Available on tablets, foldables, and desktop.
settings_appearance.goal_celebrations_desc: Confetti when you hit a milestone
settings_appearance.page_banners_desc: Header style at the top of every page. Animated is a compact accent-gradient bar with a chosen motion style, Gradient is the same bar, static, Off is a plain glass header.
settings_appearance.anim_style_desc: Shimmer is a soft white sweep, Drift is a slow hue rotation, Pulse is a gentle breathing, Aurora is a soft accent-tinted cloud-of-light. All honour Reduce Motion.

goals.weekly_desc: Target number of training days per week
goals.keep_awake_desc: Keep the screen on during workouts
goals.calorie_est_desc: Approximate kcal per workout (Mifflin-St Jeor BMR + MET). Needs height, weight, date of birth, and sex set in Profile. Resistance-training estimates are loose by ±25%, treated as an "~est" badge in the UI, not a hard number.

logging.autofill_desc: Pre-fill weight and reps from your last session
logging.summary_desc: Show stats recap when all sets are done
logging.auto_collapse_desc: Collapse a card once every set is ticked, tap to re-expand
logging.auto_name_desc: Name empty workouts from exercise categories (Push Day, Pull Day, etc.)
logging.reorder_desc: How to reorder exercises in the diary
logging.confirm_remove_desc: Ask before removing an exercise or superset from the diary
logging.warmups_desc: When a template loads with target weights, prepend bar / 50% / 70% / 85% warm-ups. You can always add or remove them per-exercise.
logging.rpe_desc: Log Rate of Perceived Exertion (6–10 scale) on each completed set. Useful for autoregulated programs.

rest.duration_desc: Default, remembered per-exercise after first use
rest.auto_start_desc: Start rest timer when you check off a set
rest.alert_desc: Get notified when the timer finishes
rest.tone_desc: Brief chime when the timer hits zero
rest.tone_style_desc: Tap a row to select, tap ▶ to preview

body_stats.toggle_desc: Toggle which stats appear in the diary body stats sheet

push.test_failed_hint: {provider} test failed, check the URL and credentials below
push.device_desc_native: System notifications shown by Android in the status bar and on the lock screen
push.perm_hint_native: Android needs permission to show notifications.
push.perm_hint_web: The browser needs permission to show notifications.
push.push_service_desc: External push delivery (Gotify, ntfy, or Apprise)

reminders.rest_day_desc: Reminds you to recover after training days
reminders.streak_desc: Warns when your streak is at risk

alerts.complete_desc: Celebrate when all sets are done
alerts.prs_desc: Celebrate when you hit a new PR
alerts.coach_feedback_desc: Ping when your coach leaves a note on a workout

coach.member_completes_desc: Push when a member finishes a workout you prescribed for that day
coach.member_missed_desc: Push the morning after a dated prescription's day passes without a completed workout
coach.member_reply_desc: Push when a coachee replies to one of your notes

summaries.weekly_desc: Push + email digest of your training week
